title: People Also Ask
content: People Also Ask is a Google results feature that lists questions related to a search, each expanding to show a short answer and a link to its source.

meta.why: The listed questions show how people phrase the next question on a topic, which is useful input for headings and for the prompts you track.
meta.example: A search for inventory software shows related questions about cost, options for small businesses, and spreadsheet alternatives.
meta.check: Search your main topics, record the related questions shown, and confirm your pages answer the ones relevant to your buyers.
meta.limitation: The questions vary by query, location, and date. Treat a recorded list as a snapshot.
meta.sources: Google Search Central: visual elements gallery | https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/visual-elements-gallery | Platform documentation
